summary: Murder Row emphasizes interrupt coverage, dispel variety, environmental objects, and planned use of boss cover mechanics.
actions: Interrupt Fel Missiles, Seduction, Felstorm, Fel Rage, Health Funnel, and Chaos Bolt.
Plan dispels for Corroding Spittle, Heartstop Poison, Murder in a Row, and Curse of Doom; use offensive removal on Back to Work and Fel Rage when appropriate.
Collect Fel Crystals in the opening area and exchange them with vendors for dungeon buffs.
On Zaen, use the first Fire Bomb set to destroy the first Fel Barrel and preserve the second barrel as cover for Murder in a Row.
On Lithiel, keep summoned adds controlled and use the group gateway interaction to cross the expanding Malefic Wave.

provenance.description: Original compact strategy summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
